24861.d: Spirit trees are a gnomic method of transportation.

gt.heading: Accessibility
gt.text:
The fastest way to access a spirit tree is through a spirit tree re-rooter.

A free means would be to plant a spirit tree at Manor Farm and use the Manor farm Teleport (unlocked with medium Ardougne achievements) to teleport there.

The ring of duelling teleport to the Warforge Dig Site brings you within a few steps of the South Feldip Hills tree.

Other fast ways to teleport include using an Arc journal, Captain's Log, or explorer's ring 3/4 cabbage-port to Port Sarim or to use the South Feldip Hills Teleport spell to the South Feldip Hills tree.

With the easy Ardougne achievements completed and claimed the Ardougne cloak 1, players can use the Kandarin monastery Teleport and use the Khazard Battlefield tree to the west.

When the player has completed the easy Varrock achievements, they can swap their Varrock Teleport destination to the Grand Exchange and use the spirit tree there. 

With completion of Plague's End, a crystal teleport seed or attuned crystal teleport seed can be used to teleport to the Crwys district very close to the Prifddinas Spirit Tree.

If the player has built a spirit tree in their player-owned house, it can be extremely close to the House Teleport destination.
